summary: The StaffConsentForms system manages the creation, updating, retrieving, and deletion of staff consent forms, involving details about the staff member, provider, and the agency.
purpose: To handle the lifecycle of staff consent forms, ensuring that all necessary data is captured, validated, and stored accurately.

Add parameters and execute the "StaffConsentFormsAdd" procedure.

workflows.name: Update StaffConsentForm

Add parameters and execute the "StaffConsentFormsUpdate" procedure.
